Definition: from G746 and G4166; a head shepherd:--chief shepherd.
BiblicalUsage: The word is chief shepherd, and it appears once, when Peter promises the elders that when the chief Shepherd appears, they shall receive a crown of glory that does not fade away.
TheologicalSignificance: Every shepherd answers to the chief Shepherd, and His appearing is the payday for faithful ones.
